caption.text:
50 Python drills to crack any data interview 🐍

One shared orders and customers dataset. Every drill solved, so you stop memorising syntax and start recognising patterns.

What's inside, in order:

▪️ The shared dataset
▪️ Comprehensions and filtering
▪️ Sorting with keys
▪️ Grouping with dict, defaultdict and Counter
▪️ String processing
▪️ itertools
▪️ Functions and closures
▪️ Generators
▪️ Error handling
▪️ Interview problems: top-k, dedupe, sliding window
▪️ Cheatsheet: Python drill idioms

Work through them once and the common interview questions stop feeling new.

Save this for your next prep session and send it to the friend who is job hunting.

Comment “python” to get every query and answer as a PDF.
